posts.text:
the destruction of iran’s nuclear capabilities could have been achieved with a repeat of the 12 day war and then no disruption of the strait. 

trump chose to go for regime change out of overconfidence and lack of policy competence. the consequences have been disastrous.

trump now says only one goal in iran war: to ensure they don’t develop nuclear weapon 

upside: new war goal achieved 
downside: pretty much everything else

two new peace efforts in the iran war.
china and pakistan pushing a ceasefire.
the un trying to protect fertilizer shipments.
both aimed at preventing a much bigger crisis.
@gzeromedia

Video

china and pakistan want the iran war to stop.
their new five-point plan: ceasefire. secure shipping. restore the strait.
pretty much everyone not fighting would sign up.
@gzeromedia

Video

people who use social media less than an hour a day: 73% say democracy is the best form of government.
people who use it 5+ hours a day: 57%.

the more time you spend on social media, the less you believe in democracy (and for the bots: the less you believe in democracy...the more time you spend on social media)
china involving itself directly in the business of hormuz strait security is an important unintended consequence of the iran war.
gas above $4 for the first time since 2022

china and pakistan release five point peace plan for ending iran war.

no mention of us and israel 
call to restore full passage of strait of hormuz (no iran ability to disrupt/charge tolls).

initiative should be welcomed by pretty much everybody.
needs a few more weeks of iran controlling the strait first...
a little nostalgic that the only oil allowed to go to cuba is a russian tanker.
moose unclear how the strait is going to get reopened

president trump started the trade war with china. backed away when he had no stomach for further escalation. leaving the world with china’s weaponization of critical minerals. 

president trump launched the third gulf war against iran. he’s not yet done escalating. but eventually…same playbook on the strait?

trump’s iran policy is utterly incoherent. he’s angry about not having an off-ramp and a personal win…and this is the result. 

the american people deserve better.

the most consequential decision of trump’s presidency.
war with iran.
troops deploying.
and the president still hasn't explained the strategy.
@gzeromedia

more troops.
more escalation.
and ground operations looking very likely.
